description: A Multimodal Railway Vibration and Vision Dataset (Rail-VIVID) is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sizhe Ma et al. Indirect, onboard monitoring of railway track infrastructure can help improve safety and operational efficiency, yet its adoption remains limited due to the complexity of real-world data. Coverage: global; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, Image, Point cloud. The data are held in Hugging Face and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
